Sorry about this one, Andy. Your Thor X1 is paid but hasn't shipped, and it's well past the window it should have gone out in, so I'm not going to quote you a date I can't stand behind. I've pinged the team to confirm the current ship date, and there's a detail on the order I want them to check: the unit on it is the US-plug version and it's going to (address hidden).

Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here. If you step away, you'll get it by email.

I ordered a Thor X1 on the 19th of August. Since then I have emailed and accepted a Bitfortun bs1 though after watching some videos highlighting the fake 400Gh I asked for a refund. Then I sent a total of three emails as my order sill shows a Thor X1 expecting details and no sign of a refund. I finally got a reply from support and reluctantly accepted a Bitfortun bs1, which I thought would come with a UK mains plug and have Harlo OS installed. Yet the above order number still shows a Thor X1 waiting for tracking details. How can I track my order or are you trying to forget itin the hope I do too?

Andrew T.
Handed to the team · Agreed swap was never applied to the order; can't confirm UK plug or a date, and

You're right, Andrew, and I'm sorry. We wrote on September 6 offering the BS-1 swap, you accepted, but it was never applied. The order still reads Thor X1, nothing has shipped, so there's no tracking to give you. Nobody's forgetting you.

I can put the BS-1 on the order right now. Before I do, I've asked the team to confirm the UK plug and a real ship date, since the BS-1 is showing no stock, and to make sure the swap costs you nothing.

Stay in the chat, they'll jump in here.
